description: This file implements a Matrix direct message room tracker, managing direct message detection, cache management, and room promotion logic.

methods.name: rememberBounded
methods.description: Maintains a bounded size Map by removing oldest entries when exceeding max size.

methods.name: createDirectRoomTracker
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns an object with methods to manage direct message rooms and detect direct messages.

methods.name: ensureSelfUserId
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and caches the user's own ID from the Matrix client.

methods.name: refreshDmCache
methods.description: Updates the direct message cache if TTL has expired.

methods.name: resolveJoinedMembers
methods.description: Resolves and caches the list of joined members in a room.

methods.name: resolveDirectMemberFlag
methods.description: Checks and caches if a user has a direct matrix member flag in a room.

methods.name: hasRecentInviteCandidate
methods.description: Checks if a room has a recent invite from a specific user within TTL.

methods.name: canPromoteRecentInvite
methods.description: Determines if a recent invite can be promoted to a direct room.

methods.name: shouldKeepLocallyPromotedDirectRoom
methods.description: Checks if a locally promoted direct room should be kept based on options.

methods.name: hasLocallyPromotedDirectRoom
methods.description: Checks if a room has been locally promoted for a specific user.

methods.name: rememberLocallyPromotedDirectRoom
methods.description: Marks a room as locally promoted for a specific user.
